scientific_integrity.computation_role: Finite independent corroboration only; the complete mathematical proof supplies all quantifiers.
limitations: No formula or new bound for the actual minimum partial-DFA bandwidth is claimed.
Equality of the two estimators at bounded values is not excluded.
Equivalent results in unindexed literature may exist.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Elementary layer lifting, consecutive-layer packing, fixed-radius/large-radius asymptotics, explicit binary residual-language family.
scientific_integrity.proved_scope: Finite nonempty-word-containing languages over every fixed finite alphabet with at least two symbols; sharp asymptotic comparison of two specified bandwidth estimators.

title: A sharp fixed-alphabet half-gap for deterministic bandwidth estimators
